recipe.visualDefinition: A front-facing view of a bass drum head featuring a vibrant cyan-to-teal gradient background. The drum is framed by a black rim with chrome tension lugs. Centered on the drum skin is a multi-layered typographic lockup using bold, geometric sans-serif fonts in contrasting yellow and black.
coreVisualRelationships: Circular frame of the drum contains the entire typographic composition.
High contrast between the yellow primary text and the cyan background.
Secondary black text provides a grounded visual weight below the bright primary text.
coreInvariants: Chrome hardware evenly spaced around the perimeter
Radial gradient on the drum skin surface

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The drum head is centered, filling approximately 85% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large yellow lowercase text in the upper-center of the drum skin.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright yellow text, moves down to the heavy black text, then outward to the metallic drum hardware.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Clean white background surrounding the drum; open cyan space around the central text block.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cyan/Teal gradient for the drum skin surface.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow for the primary display text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Black for the secondary text and drum rim; Chrome for hardware.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the cyan and yellow; high value contrast between black text and bright background.

letterConstructionRules: Tight kerning with some character overlap
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'l' as a simple vertical bar

composition.relationshipToImage: anchors the bottom of the text block

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast through color and case (lowercase yellow vs. title case black) while maintaining a consistent geometric sans-serif family.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and tight kerning capabilities.
Provides the necessary weight and geometric purity.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio shot of a bass drum facing forward on a white background. The drum skin is a smooth cyan-to-teal radial gradient. The rim is black with polished chrome lugs and hardware at the bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a centered typographic lockup. The top word is large, lowercase, and bright yellow. The bottom word is slightly smaller, title case, extra-bold black, and positioned to slightly overlap or sit very close to the word above it.

verificationChecks: Is the drum head perfectly circular?
Is the yellow text lowercase and the black text title case?
Is the background a cyan gradient?
Are the chrome lugs visible around the rim?

adjustableVariables: Gradient intensity of the cyan background
Number of chrome lugs on the rim

mustAchieve: Smooth color transitions in the gradient
avoid: Mismatched lighting between drum and background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is perfectly centered horizontally.
Check that the chrome hardware looks metallic and not grey.
Verify the yellow is vibrant and not muddy.
Confirm the drum rim is a solid, clean black circle.
recipe.reuseFormula: Centralize a bold geometric sans-serif typographic lockup on a high-contrast, single-instrument studio object using a complementary two-tone color palette.
